0022600035.text: The Orlando Magic (4-7) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-11) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, the 12th of the 2026-27 season for Orlando, which has won its last two games but is 0-4 at home. Milwaukee has lost eight straight and is 0-5 on the road. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Milwaukee's Myles Turner (rest) and Ryan Rollins (head) are also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and Orlando won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 130-91 win in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
